contracts: detect -> root cause -> regression -> minimal fix -> retest -> deploy/readback verify -> ledger -> prevention
green means outcome verified, not technical success alone
one authoritative source -> bounded delta -> cached/projected state -> deterministic processing -> AI only on material uncertainty -> one deduplicated write
no blind mass mutation; one reversible hypothesis at a time
no duplicate periodic owner without explicit orchestration
protected publishing, approval, security, commercial freshness and idempotency contracts may not be traded away for cost

lessons.symptom: GET /v2/data-stores/{id}/data/{key} returns 404 even when the key exists.
lessons.rootCause: Make datastore records support bounded list reads plus write/update by key, but exact GET-by-key is not a supported read contract in this environment.
lessons.failedApproach: Re-attempt exact GET for mission-control/team-context cache because PATCH-by-key works.
lessons.fix: Use bounded list GET with the smallest safe pg[limit], ideally a dedicated one-record datastore for hot projections.
lessons.evidence: BG186/BG139 exact-key experiments returned 404; BG190 bounded list cache read succeeded; dedicated PH Team Context Cache v1 works with pg[limit]=1.
lessons.prevention: Never infer read endpoints from write endpoints; verify API semantics before architecture changes.

lessons.symptom: Repeated id[]/cols[] query keys in makeApiCall qs collapse to only the last value.
lessons.rootCause: Make mapper serialization does not preserve repeated query keys in qs.
lessons.failedApproach: Send repeated id[] or cols[] entries through mapper qs.
lessons.fix: Encode repeated array query parameters directly in the request URL.
lessons.evidence: BG150 two-ID probe returned both scenarios only after repeated id%5B%5D/cols%5B%5D were encoded in URL; production run 2a2876e5803249d79adcc67761b0709a succeeded at 3 ops/4 credits/2091 bytes.
lessons.prevention: Use explicit URL repetition for Make API array query params and regression-test count/fields.

lessons.symptom: Repeated daily cost snapshot invocations read a large Make scenario inventory before discovering today's snapshot already exists.
lessons.rootCause: Idempotency check was placed after the expensive source read.
lessons.fix: Notion precheck for today's snapshot first; only execute expensive inventory when absent.
lessons.evidence: Duplicate BG159 run c35c7bbec62d4f4ea9e3b264c1310529: 2 ops/3 credits/13122 bytes versus historical ~4 ops/6 credits/~1 MB.
lessons.prevention: Every scheduled snapshot/collector places stable-key existence check before broad source inventory.

lessons.symptom: Read-heavy cockpit/API paths fan out to Notion/Datahub on ordinary reads.
lessons.fix: Cache-first bounded datastore read, TTL 3600, write-through on miss, browser cache 3600 with stale-while-revalidate.
lessons.evidence: BG190 execution bdb6748984cf46a1b363a5f9741d30a8: CACHE source, 2 ops/3 credits/31387 bytes, no Notion fan-out; BG139 recent cache-hit ~4 ops/5 credits/~22 KB versus historical ~7/8/~71 KB.
lessons.prevention: Normal read paths must be cache-first; cache hit must never invoke live source fan-out.

lessons.symptom: Notion idempotency API returns 400 Error parsing JSON body; rendered key contains escaped literal pipe between mapped expressions.
lessons.rootCause: Hand-built JSON mixed mapped expressions and literal separators, causing invalid escaped JSON.
lessons.failedApproach: concat() workaround where function is unavailable; hand-editing mapped JSON separators.
lessons.fix: Build query body deterministically in JavaScript with JSON.stringify and pass the completed JSON string.
lessons.evidence: Rebuilt BG84 v1.6 scenario 7163276 no-op execution 40382c74180e450eaab5ae3533b531c5 succeeded at 1 op/1 credit/27 bytes; old v1.5 deactivated.
lessons.prevention: Complex API JSON bodies are serialized in code/JSON transformer, not assembled across mapping/literal boundaries.

lessons.symptom: Scheduled intelligence flows read one Notion record solely to start execution although downstream does not reference it.
lessons.rootCause: A data connector was used as a scheduler trigger instead of a deterministic scenario start.
lessons.fix: Replace dummy read with StartSubscenario/scheduled deterministic root while preserving actual downstream queries.
lessons.evidence: BG126, BG127, BG128 each dropped one operation/credit and material transfer after replacement.
lessons.prevention: Scheduled scenarios use a zero-data deterministic trigger unless the trigger record itself is business input.

lessons.symptom: PH agents either fail exact datastore GET or ingest excessive full team context.
lessons.rootCause: Hot shared context lived in a broad datastore and exact-key reads were assumed to work; worker prompts carried unnecessary team-wide JSON.
lessons.fix: Dedicated one-record datastore PH Team Context Cache v1 (175713), BG167 dual-write for compatibility, worker list GET pg[limit]=1, mission-relevant context projection.
lessons.evidence: BG167 execution 59213fcb34274195bb2ba7b0221250a6 proved dedicated write; PH01/PH04/PH14 runtime canaries read current TEAM-CONTRACT. PH01 compact canary 3124->1855 input tokens and 21.37->12.77 credits; PH11 4083->3203 input tokens and 27.21->21.65 credits.
lessons.prevention: Separate stable shared state from request overlay; workers receive compact mission-specific context, not raw shared memory.

lessons.symptom: Healthy cache/canary responses are logged as AGENT_ERROR because output mentions the word error in quoted/contextual text.
lessons.rootCause: Keyword-based classifier ignored semantic negation and healthy-canary patterns.
lessons.fix: Classify verification/canary plus explicit no-change/healthy outcome as NO_ACTION; normalize healthy phrasing such as 'Shared team context available'.
lessons.evidence: Previously false PH09/PH01 learning outputs reclassified to NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE; BG168 stops at 1 op/2 credits without BG166/Notion/BG167 fan-out.
lessons.prevention: Learning materiality classifiers use semantic outcome state and negation before keyword error detection.

lessons.symptom: Learning write can exceed Notion rich_text limits; duplicate lookup returns a full page although only fingerprint existence is needed.
lessons.fix: Bound learning context to safe length and project dedupe query to only Lering/fingerprint field.
lessons.evidence: Oversized 4164-character regression event wrote successfully; duplicate fingerprint stopped at 3 ops/5 credits/~5.1 KB.
lessons.prevention: Ledger payloads are bounded; dedupe existence queries retrieve only identity field.

lessons.symptom: Cost governor performs a broad datastore scan before deciding an event is duplicate.
lessons.rootCause: Dedupe was read-first instead of relying on unique-key reservation semantics.
lessons.fix: Atomically POST reservation by fingerprint first; duplicate-key collision terminates via safe error handler before specialist chain.
lessons.evidence: Unique event ~3 ops/4 credits/~3.6 KB; duplicate ~2 ops/3 credits/~2.1 KB; protected routes preserved after rebuild.
lessons.prevention: Where store uniqueness is authoritative, prefer atomic reserve-first dedupe over broad pre-scan.

lessons.symptom: Multiple overlapping narrative runs process the same Notion candidate set through AI.
lessons.rootCause: No run-level lock before candidate read/AI.
lessons.fix: 10-minute atomic run lock before Notion and AI; duplicate lock collision stops run.
lessons.evidence: Three overlapping runs previously consumed ~292 credits; duplicate lock verification stops at 2 ops/3 credits with zero Notion/AI calls.
lessons.prevention: Expensive scheduled AI pipelines require an overlap lock longer than normal runtime and shorter than legitimate cadence.

lessons.symptom: Guardian reads ~359 KB team inventory and only afterwards returns OUTSIDE_DAILY_GUARD_WINDOW.
lessons.rootCause: Cheap time eligibility gate was placed after expensive inventory.
lessons.fix: Evaluate guard window first; only then request projected scenario inventory fields id/name/lastEdit/isinvalid.
lessons.evidence: Outside window reduced to 1 op/2 credits/147 bytes; projected inventory probe ~38 KB versus ~359 KB.
lessons.prevention: All guardians put deterministic time/scope gates before remote inventory and request only consumed columns.

lessons.symptom: Control-plane JSON is schema-valid but runtime values contain commercial advice/channel fields instead of configuration values.
lessons.rootCause: Generic commercial BG89 writeback treated Powerhouse Control Plane Runtime mirror rows as opportunities and overwrote runtime fields.
lessons.failedApproach: Treat HTTP success/schema correctness as proof of control-plane correctness or merely cache the corrupt mirror more cheaply.
lessons.fix: Exclude control-plane rows from BG89; restore 12 rows from intact canonical source; verify exact key/value/type/enabled invariants.
lessons.evidence: Readback restored cacheSeconds=300, remoteRefreshSeconds=60 and governance booleans=true across 12/12 controls.
lessons.prevention: Control-plane regression requires semantic invariants; generic Datahub writebacks use explicit record-class allowlists/exclusions.

lessons.symptom: Health/test/control/operational Datahub events receive Opportunity scores, deadlines and commercial advice.
lessons.rootCause: Generic Notion create-watch treated all new non-duplicate Datahub rows as commercial evidence; watchDatabaseItems transfers complete wide pages and offers no property projection.
lessons.failedApproach: Assume shared schema means commercial eligibility; blanket-exclude whole mixed sources; increase polling to clear backlog.
lessons.fix: Pre-scoring gate excludes Duplicate, Control Plane Runtime, Radar Heartbeat, Regression Test, network_snapshot and already Opportunity Updated; retain real inbound DM/action signals.
lessons.evidence: Backlog measured 410 unscored records, including 234 Radar Heartbeats. Natural execution b97fc302e50346f3b658be9ec9886757 received 10 trigger rows and only 9 reached scoring after heartbeat exclusion. Fetched heartbeat states coverage health only/no AI; fetched DM sample contains real inbound action context.
lessons.prevention: Every generic Datahub consumer declares eligible record classes/subtypes before code/AI/write. Migrate broad watch paths via shadow to bounded projected query and prove output equivalence before cutover.

lessons.symptom: Multiple active watchers/guardians own overlapping periodic responsibility.
lessons.risk: Duplicate cost/logs, races, retries and side effects.
lessons.prevention: Exactly one periodic owner per invariant class unless explicit orchestrator partitions scope.

lessons.symptom: Content item is blocked because required visual/media is absent.
lessons.rule: This is a valid production/approval gate, not a publisher failure; do not retry publisher. Produce visual, obtain approvals, then publish and verify public ID/URL.
lessons.prevention: Cost optimization may never bypass required media/brand/narrative gates.

lessons.symptom: BG186 reports ACTIVE/CACHE_HIT without current BG191 Class-A promotion evidence.
lessons.rule: Treat as false green/unauthorized active drift; restore BYPASS and verify readback until promotion evidence exists.
lessons.prevention: Operational state must be causally backed by current promotion evidence, not merely cached flag values.

agent_preflight: fingerprint-match this file plus powerhouse-chat-learning-checkpoint before material Make/Notion/agent work
do not rediscover a known endpoint/configuration limitation
place cheapest deterministic eligibility/dedupe/time gate before broad reads, AI and writes
measure equivalent baseline/post executions; never compare a blocked path to a full-work path as if equivalent
after a material new failure/fix, append ledger evidence and refresh shared context
